passage.label: Whatever heavens earth exalting Allah Sovereign Pure Exalted Might Wise; He sent among unlettered Messenger from themselves reciting verses purifying teaching Book wisdom although before clear error; and others not yet joined them Exalted Might Wise; that bounty Allah gives whom wills possessor great bounty

arabicExcerpts.text: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡمَلِكِ ٱلۡقُدُّوسِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
هُوَ ٱلَّذِي بَعَثَ فِي ٱلۡأُمِّيِّـۧنَ رَسُولٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمۡ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَإِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنۡهُمۡ لَمَّا يَلۡحَقُواْ بِهِمۡۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
ذَٰلِكَ فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

mainSubject.label: Universal tasbih affirming the Sovereign, Pure, Mighty and Wise; the sending among the unlettered of a Messenger from themselves who recites His verses, purifies them and teaches the Book and wisdom despite their prior clear error; this mission extending to others not yet joined, under might and wisdom; all named as Allah's bounty given by will to the possessor of great bounty

subordinateSubjects.label: All in heavens and earth exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise
He sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves reciting verses, purifying them and teaching the Book and wisdom despite prior clear error
This mission extending to others not yet joined them, under His might and wisdom
All of it named Allah's bounty given by will to the possessor of great bounty

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Prior state of clear error before the Messenger's arrival

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Messenger sent among the unlettered from themselves to recite, purify and teach

relationships.label: Universal tasbih opening the surah with four divine names
Mission extending to others not yet joined, framed entirely as divine bounty

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the bounty declaration (4) before the Torah-donkey parable opens (5); P2 ends with the inevitable-death disclosure (8) before the Friday command begins (9); P3 covers the Jumu'ah obligation, post-prayer dispersal and the trade-diversion rebuke (9-11).
